@staticmethod
    def _occ3_pin_mask(logits, lengths, row_starts, pin):
        """OCC-3 per-row pin: force [start, start+count) into the top-k.

        ``pin`` is (start, count, forced): int32 device tensors with one entry
        per logits row, in the same row order and expansion as ``lengths``.
        Rows with count 0 (every ordinary request) write their own gathered
        value back, so their logits stay bitwise unchanged. Fixed shapes, no
        host sync and no data-dependent branch: CUDA-graph safe. Columns use
        the same space as init tokens: ``row_starts + position``.
        """
        start, count, forced = pin
        rows = logits.shape[0]
        start = start[:rows].to(lengths.dtype)
        count = count[:rows].to(lengths.dtype)
        lanes = torch.arange(128, dtype=lengths.dtype, device=lengths.device)[None, :]
        base = (row_starts[:rows] if row_starts is not None else torch.zeros_like(start)) + start
        width = logits.shape[-1] - 1
        idx = (base[:, None] + lanes).clamp(0, width)
        valid = (lanes < count[:, None]) & ((start[:, None] + lanes) < lengths[:rows, None])
        idx0 = base.clamp(0, width)[:, None]
        valid0 = valid[:, :1]
        idx = torch.where(valid, idx, idx0)
        inf = torch.full_like(logits[:, :1], float("inf"))
        fill0 = torch.where(valid0, inf, logits.gather(1, idx0))
        src = torch.where(valid, inf.expand(-1, idx.shape[1]), fill0.expand(-1, idx.shape[1]))
        logits.scatter_(1, idx.long(), src)
        forced[:rows].copy_(valid.sum(dim=1).to(forced.dtype))
        return logits
